latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Hyperliquid read-only market data assistant.
- Supports natural language, terminal-style (`hl ...`), and slash-style (`/hl ...`) commands.
- Fetches real-time market data: quotes, top movers, funding rankings, L2 order book, and candle snapshots via Hyperliquid API.
- Includes read-only account queries: positions, balances, open orders, and fills, with local account alias management.
